pages.text: The Wireless Crafting Grid is a portable version of the regular Crafting Grid that allows you to craft items and access your storage network from anywhere within range of a Wireless Transmitter. In RS2, it features improved wireless performance and better power efficiency. Note: This item requires the Quartz Arsenal mod to be installed.

To use the Wireless Crafting Grid:$(li)Right-click while holding it to open the interface$(li)Insert a Network Card to connect to a wireless network$(li)Use it within range of a configured Wireless Transmitter$(li)Access your items and craft just like a regular Crafting Grid$(li)Requires Quartz Arsenal mod

The Wireless Crafting Grid supports all the same features as a regular Crafting Grid, including:$(li)Enhanced viewing and managing items$(li)Improved searching and filtering$(li)Better sorting and grouping$(li)Advanced Grid Filters$(li)Crafting items using the 3x3 crafting grid$(li)Faster autocrafting pattern access$(br2)Note: This item is only available when Quartz Arsenal is installed.
